title: ZenFlow: Enabling Stall-Free Offloading for LLM Training
abstract: arXiv:2505.12242v4 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Fine-tuning large language models (LLMs) often exceeds GPU memory limits, prompting systems to offload model states to CPU memory. However, existing offloaded training frameworks like ZeRO-Offload treat all parameters equally and update the full model on the CPU, causing severe GPU stalls, where fast, expensive GPUs sit idle, waiting for slow CPU updates and limited-bandwidth PCIe transfers. We present ZenFlow, a new offloaded training framework that decouples updates between GPU and CPU by prioritizing important gradients. ZenFlow performs in-place updates of important gradients on GPU while offloading and accumulating less important ones on CPU without blocking training iterations, fully overlapping CPU work with GPU computation. translated_title: ZenFlow：为大语言模型训练实现无停顿的卸载
translated_abstract: 微调大语言模型（LLM）通常超出GPU内存限制，促使系统将模型状态卸载到CPU内存。然而，现有的卸载训练框架（如ZeRO-Offload）对所有参数一视同仁，并在CPU上更新整个模型，导致严重的GPU停顿——快速且昂贵的GPU处于闲置状态，等待缓慢的CPU更新和带宽受限的PCIe传输。我们提出了ZenFlow，这是一种新的卸载训练框架，通过优先处理重要梯度来解耦GPU与CPU之间的更新。ZenFlow在GPU上对重要梯度进行原位更新，同时在CPU上卸载并累积不重要的梯度，而不阻塞训练迭代，使CPU工作与GPU计算完全重叠。为了使这种重要性感知的设计具有可扩展性，ZenFlow利用了重要梯度的一种新颖的时空局部性——重要梯度集中于特定位置且在迭代过程中保持稳定——以...
tldr: ZenFlow提出了一种新型卸载训练框架，通过利用重要梯度的时空局部性，在GPU上原位更新重要梯度、同时在CPU上异步累积次要梯度并完全重叠CPU工作与GPU计算，从而消除大语言模型训练中的GPU停顿。
en_tdlr: ZenFlow is a new offloaded training framework that eliminates GPU stalls in LLM training by exploiting the spatio-temporal locality of important gradients, updating them in-place on GPU while asynchronously accumulating less important ones on CPU to fully overlap CPU work with GPU computation.
